invariants.rationale: The method returns HoodieListData.eager(data), which is never null.
The result is constructed with HoodieListData.eager(data), so collecting as list yields the original data.
If data is empty, the result will also collect as an empty list, so implication holds.
The result reflects all elements of the input data list, preserving size.
This is a property of the parameter as seen at this point (trivially always true but not tautological in comparison semantics).
